mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate signals a robust demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate below 4.5% triggers an easing monetary cycle, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate above 5% signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of high unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production signals a strong supply environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The joint behavior of GDP growth rate and housing starts signals a robust demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth and housing starts (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate below 4.5% and an increase in the money supply trigger an easing monetary cycle, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during periods of low unemployment.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong payroll employment and low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate and a decline in the unemployment rate signal a robust demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth and low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).
